name: School Management
description: A school database with students, teachers, courses, and enrollments.
setupSql: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, age INTEGER, grade TEXT); CREATE TABLE teachers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT, department TEXT); CREATE TABLE courses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, teacher_id INTEGER REFERENCES teachers(id), credits INTEGER); CREATE TABLE enrollments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER REFERENCES students(id), course_id INTEGER REFERENCES courses(id), grade TEXT, semester TEXT); INSERT INTO students VALUES (1, 'Alice', 20, 'Freshman'); INSERT INTO students VALUES (2, 'Bob', 21, 'Sophomore'); INSERT INTO students VALUES (3, 'Charlie', 19, 'Freshman'); INSERT INTO students VALUES (4, 'Diana', 22, 'Senior'); INSERT INTO students VALUES (5, 'Eve', 20, 'Sophomore'); INSERT INTO teachers VALUES (1, 'Dr. Smith', 'Math', 'Science'); INSERT INTO teachers VALUES (2, 'Prof. Johnson', 'English', 'Humanities'); INSERT INTO teachers VALUES (3, 'Dr. Williams', 'Science', 'Science'); INSERT INTO teachers VALUES (4, 'Prof. Brown', 'History', 'Humanities'); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (1, 'Algebra', 1, 4); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (2, 'English Literature', 2, 3); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (3, 'Physics', 3, 4); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (4, 'World History', 4, 3); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (5, 'Calculus', 1, 4); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (1, 1, 1, 'A', 'Fall 2023'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (2, 1, 2, 'B', 'Fall 2023'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (3, 2, 1, 'A', 'Fall 2023'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (4, 2, 3, 'B+', 'Fall 2023'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (5, 3, 2, 'A-', 'Fall 2023'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (6, 3, 4, 'B', 'Spring 2024'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (7, 4, 1, 'A', 'Fall 2023'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (8, 4, 5, 'A-', 'Spring 2024'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (9, 5, 3, 'B+', 'Fall 2023'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (10, 5, 4, 'A', 'Spring 2024');
